PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.PHASE_GATE: v2.5.1 public Linux/macOS feedback release remains the latest published release; the local v2.5.2 development line has completed Phase-16 traceability/LDD/maintainability polish and is ready for release-candidate gates.
PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a public Linux/macOS feedback-release developer tool with feedback-driven MyGRACE ergonomics. Phase-16 raises the v2.5.2 line to strict 100.0% traceability, full belief-state baseline coverage, zero canonical drift, zero strict non-human warnings, and lower MCP GRACE handler size pressure.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 85 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards; 94/94 contracted files, 649 function contracts, and 1002 closed semantic blocks after Phase-16.
EVIDENCE.LOCAL_CI_GATE: scripts/ci.sh passed locally on 2026-05-21: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, runtime panic guard, 185 tests, release version guard, release freshness guard, release-candidate dry-run, release/install smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full --ci, refresh --json, and status --json.
EVIDENCE.HOSTED_CI_GATE: GitHub Actions run 26157234065 passed on main after commit 820fc7ed336b4ab2fc262f2239d05077ae2b1821, including Linux/macOS platform tests, MyGRACE gate, security audit, fresh-install smoke, and release-smoke matrix.
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_VERSION_TRUTH: Tag v2.5.1 is published at the verified release line, and the release workflow generated Linux/macOS artifacts plus SHA256SUMS. The main development line targets v2.5.2, with release freshness guards expected to treat v2.5.2 as unpublished until the Phase-16 release commit is pushed and tagged.
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: The installer still prefers signed-off release artifacts plus SHA256SUMS verification. Source fallback is now explicit: SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF for hosted fresh-install smoke, selected Git tag when available, and default main branch only during the pre-tag release-candidate window.
EVIDENCE.FRESH_INSTALL_TRUTH: Push CI fresh-install smoke uses raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact workflow commit plus SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF, preventing a current-HEAD smoke job from silently installing an older release tag. A post-release public-tag smoke also passed against https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anyagixx/synapse/v2.5.1/install.sh and installed syn 2.5.1 from the release artifact.
EVIDENCE.PACKAGE_TRUTH: The Cargo package is synapse-agent to avoid the crates.io syn parser conflict; the public binary and library crate remain syn.
EVIDENCE.MCP_CLI_TRUTH: syn mcp is public stdio-only. verify_project/review_code and syn verify/review now expose profile-aware strictness without changing the strict CI default.
EVIDENCE.NO_ACTIVE_PHASE_TRUTH: docs/plan-index.xml now has ACTIVE_PHASE none after all phase shards are done; status and refresh preserve that state instead of reporting a completed phase as active.
EVIDENCE.DOC_TRUTH: Public README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, WORKFLOW, and SUPPORT docs are guarded against ghost CLI commands, unsupported flags, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete release paths, unsupported Windows install claims, unmeasured token-savings percentages, and misleading privacy wording.
EVIDENCE.LICENSE_TRUTH: LICENSE now contains the full Apache License 2.0 text instead of a short placeholder.
EVIDENCE.SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: install.sh --diagnose reports independent OS and architecture support status, Linux/macOS artifact mapping, install directory status, tool availability, checksum verifier status, Windows packaging deferral, and SYN_INSTALL_DIR guidance.

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred and is not part of the first Linux/macOS public release scope.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE: Real user feedback still needs to be collected across more Linux/macOS environments after the public release.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_TEST_FILE_SIZE_TARGET: tests/docs_parity.rs and tests/integration_test.rs exceed the 500-line Phase-2 maintainability target while remaining under the hard 1300-line gate.

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Commit the Phase-16 v2.5.2 release-candidate line, push main, tag and publish v2.5.2 when hosted gates pass, collect Linux/macOS user feedback, and defer Windows packaging to a later dedicated release line.
